title: Re:ZERO Season 4 Episode 14 Preview Trailer and Images Revealed
content: Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- Season 4 has revealed the Episode 14 (Episode 80 overall) preview ahead of its August 26, 2026 premiere. This will be the third episode of the second cour, which is subtitled The Recapture Arc .

title: Live-Action Ao no Hana Utsuwa no Mori Series Casts Hayate Ichinose
content: NHK announced on Tuesday that the live-action series of Yūki Kodama 's Ao no Hana Utsuwa no Mori (Blue Flower, Forest of Vessels) manga has cast Hayate Ichinose ( Kishiryū Sentai Ryusoulger ) as the male lead Tatsuki Manabe. The series will premiere on NHK 's "Yorudora" programming block this fall.
author: ANN

title: Quintet's Terranigma RPG Gets Release in 2027
content: Publisher Clear River Games announced on Monday that it will release Quintet's 1995 RPG Terranigma on Switch, Switch 2, PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC via Steam and GOG in 2027. Clear River Games describes the game: Thematic boldness. Stunning character design. Excellent music. Smooth gameplay.
author: ANN

title: Earth Defense Force 6.2 Invaders From Another World Game Announced for PS5
content: D3Publisher announced on Tuesday Earth Defense Force 6.2 INVADERS FROM ANOTHER WORLD, an updated version of its Earth Defense Force 6 game which will launch for PlayStation 5 in 2027. The updated game will include newly added enhancements for the console.
author: ANN

title: Chainsaw Man Reze Arc Movie New Visual Revealed, Heads to Prime Video in Japan on September 19
content: Chainsaw Man – The Movie: Reze Arc will begin streaming exclusively for Prime Video members in Japan on September 19, 2026, marking exactly one year since its theatrical debut. A new visual was also released alongside the announcement. Chainsaw Man International Assassins Arc anime is currently in production .
author: Anime Corner

title: 'Fall in Love, You False Angels' Manga Goes on Hiatus
content: The October issue of Kodansha 's Dessert magazine announced on Monday that Coco Uzuki 's Fall in Love, You False Angels ( Koiseyo Mayakashi Tenshi-domo ) manga will enter a hiatus, due to the creator's health, and also so she can adjust her workload.
author: ANN
